title: Exploring bosonic bound states with parallel reaction coordinates
summary: Bound states are dissipation-resilient states that may emerge when quantum systems are strongly coupled to reservoirs with band gaps. We analyze an exactly solvable bosonic model for bound state existence and reproduce these results by a weak-coupling treatment of a supersystem composed of the original system and multiple reaction coordinates, which are individually representing small energy intervals of the reservoir spectral function.
